Ray 10000 mAh Power bank Suction With Wireless Charger

The Ray 10000 mAh Power bank Suction With Wireless Charger is a next-generation portable charging solution designed for users who demand speed, convenience, and reliability. Built with a powerful 10000mAh capacity, this advanced power bank ensures your smartphones, earbuds, and other USB-powered devices stay charged throughout the day. Whether you are traveling, commuting, or working remotely, this compact yet powerful charger delivers dependable performance with a modern, durable design.

Featuring innovative suction cups, the Ray power bank securely attaches to the back of your smartphone, making it ideal for hands-free usage while charging. This unique design reduces cable clutter and prevents accidental drops during use. Combined with 15W wireless charging, the power bank allows you to charge compatible devices effortlessly without plugging in cables, offering a seamless and user-friendly charging experience.

The Ray 10000 mAh Power bank Suction With Wireless Charger also includes built-in cables, eliminating the need to carry extra accessories. With support for 22.5W fast charging, it delivers rapid power output for devices that support quick charge and power delivery standards. This makes it an excellent choice for professionals, travelers, and corporate gifting requirements where efficiency and premium utility matter most.

Key Features of Ray 10000 mAh Power bank

  • 10000mAh Capacity: Provides ample backup power for multiple device charges.
  • Suction Cups Design: Firmly attaches to smartphones for stable and secure charging.
  • 15W Wireless Charging: Fast and cable-free charging for compatible devices.
  • 22.5W Fast Charging: High-speed output for quick and efficient power delivery.
  • Built-in Cables: Integrated charging cables for added convenience and portability.
  • Durable Design: Premium build quality ensures long-lasting performance.
  • Universal Compatibility: Suitable for Android, iOS, and other USB-powered devices.

Designed with both performance and aesthetics in mind, this wireless power bank 10000mAh is compact, lightweight, and easy to carry in your pocket or bag. The durable outer shell protects the internal battery from everyday wear and tear, making it suitable for regular use. The ergonomic design ensures comfortable handling while maintaining a strong grip on your device through its suction mechanism.

The is ideal for corporate gifting, promotional giveaways, and personal use. Its premium functionality and modern appeal make it a popular choice among businesses looking for practical yet impressive tech gifts. With high utility and long-lasting battery performance, it enhances brand visibility when customized with a company logo.

Safety is a top priority with this fast charging. It is equipped with advanced protection features including overcharge protection, short circuit protection, temperature control, and voltage regulation. These features ensure safe charging for both the and connected devices, giving users peace of mind during everyday use.

If you are searching for a portable wireless charger that combines innovation, speed, and durability, the Ray stands out as a reliable solution. Its combination of suction cups, fast wireless charging, and built-in cables makes it a versatile accessory for modern lifestyles.

Why Choose Ray 10000 mAh Power bank?

  • Perfect balance of power, portability, and design
  • Ideal for travel, office, and daily use
  • Premium option for corporate gifts and promotional campaigns
  • Supports fast and wireless charging needs
